market-efficiency-s3.title: Four invented markets
market-efficiency-s3.html: Market W: many farms sell wheat to many buyers, and no one outside the market gains or loses from it. Market X: one firm is the only seller of a medicine and produces where MR = MC. Market Y: a city sets taxi fares below the equilibrium price. Market Z: many bakeries sell bread, and the government pays them $1 for every loaf sold.

externalities-s3.title: Four situations in an invented city
externalities-s3.html: (1) A cement plant's dust settles on cars nearby. (2) Students who get a flu shot also make their classmates less likely to fall ill. (3) A gardener's flower beds, planted for her own business, make the whole street nicer to walk along. (4) Late-night fireworks bought for private parties keep neighbors awake.

public-goods-s1.title: Goods sorted by rivalry and excludability
public-goods-s1.html: An invented town, Thistlebrook, has: (1) slices of pizza sold at a stand; (2) a fireworks show over the harbor that anyone in town can see; (3) fish in a lake that anyone may fish; (4) a members-only online film library with a monthly fee and plenty of capacity.

public-goods-s3.title: Fishing on Sablewood Lake
public-goods-s3.html: Sablewood Lake (invented) has no owner, and anyone may fish there. Each angler keeps every fish he catches. Over a few seasons the catch per angler falls, because the fish are taken faster than they can breed.

intervention-structures-s2.title: Taxing a monopoly ferry
intervention-structures-s2.html: The Corvel Ferry Company (invented) is the only ferry to an island. It maximizes profit by carrying 50 riders a day at $12 each, for total revenue of $600 and total cost of $400. The island council considers two taxes: a lump-sum tax of $150 a day, or a tax of $2 for every rider carried.

intervention-structures-s3.title: One minimum wage, two towns
intervention-structures-s3.html: A region sets a minimum wage. In Ardley (invented), dozens of restaurants compete to hire cooks, and the minimum wage is above the wage the market had settled at. In Pelham (invented), one large plant is the only employer of machine operators, and the minimum wage is above the wage the plant had paid but below the wage a competitive market would reach.

inequality-s3.title: Changes on the island of Corrin
inequality-s3.html: On the invented island of Corrin: (1) workers with technical training see their wages rise much faster than other workers' wages; (2) the island starts sending monthly payments to households with very low incomes; (3) a few families pass large fortunes to their children, who earn income from the land and businesses they inherit.

items.q: Use the table. What is the socially efficient number of evening hours?
